attBesluta.text: A very solid, well made box. Probably the only thing that could be improved is that the hinge screws bite into plastic fittings, this is solid but not heat-resistant. Would be ideal if these were metal nuts but easily replaced if that's what you need.

I was skeptical due to the price. When the enclosure arrived it was heavy and well-packaged. The item was built well and looks like care was given to it design and manufacturing. I will definitely order this item again.
Handig en gemakkelijk op te bouwen. Groot en hoog dus fijn voor de katten. We hebben er nog wel een plank op wielen onder gemaakt waardoor de bench nog steviger en mobieler is.

I’ve had these forks for about 2 months now. I have a bx2680 tractor. For the price you can’t go wrong. If you think about it logically, the forks are stronger than what the lifting capacity of my tractor is. For example, I have a 3 ph rototiller on a pallet, my tractor can barely lift it and the forks didn’t flex at all. I’ve used them more than I would have imagined and love them. A friend of mine spent 1000.00 on his forks and I can do 90% of the same stuff with mine. Don’t be afraid to order them, also watch for a sale, I got mine for 250 and free shipping!
